checks.name: Browser suite plus design-space unit tests
Every served figure is tracked in git
checks.result: Passes. Verified in both directions when added: unstaging one figure fails naming that file, restaging passes. It exists because seven figures 404d in a previous release while every other test was green.

checks.name: Corrections present and the superseded string absent
checks.result: Eight corrections confirmed present in the data the page renders (integer-division mechanism and the quoted driver line, 40-to-100x body size, both Reynolds speed definitions, 'no aggregation at any N', effect_size_caution, unconverged-margin wording), and the superseded '50 to 100x' asserted ABSENT rather than only checking the new string is present - which is the failure mode the author had just hit, where six prose edits matched nothing and the old text was rebuilt.

checks.name: Live figure fetch with both controls
checks.result: At the previous release all seven returned HTTP 200 at their exact byte counts, a known-good limbless figure returned 200 as positive control, and a nonexistent filename returned 404 as negative control. To be re-run after this deploy.
